question: Does the author's public doctoral thesis provide a reproducible four-sample directed-versus-diffuse density table that can independently test the fixed P6N synthetic amplitude without digitizing a figure or inferring film metadata?

source.title: Photographic film and its interaction with light: detection of dust and scratches for image restoration
source.author: Giorgio Trumpy
source.rights_boundary: Public repository download of a copyrighted thesis; internal factual measurement audit only. Do not redistribute the PDF, figures or page images.

allowed_after_pass: compare the unchanged P6N Q family against the two silver raw-density ratios as an external amplitude check
use the two dye rows as a material negative control
close the fixed P6N measured-value route without tuning if frozen compatibility gates fail
forbidden: infer sample stock, emulsion, process, scanner, illuminant spectrum or settings
treat four homogeneous fragments as a population Q curve
fit P6N parameters to the four samples
silently replace reported Q by recomputed raw-density ratios

branch_rule.source_pass: Open one fixed P6N measurement-compatibility audit with no fitting.
branch_rule.source_fail: Close this source and keep P6N synthetic-only; continue another ready leaf.

claim_ceiling: Four homogeneous-sample Callier measurements from one thesis experiment; not a Q curve, stock/process/scanner calibration, population evidence or product profile.
